name: Paladin
resourceDesc: Mana pays for every action; Conviction (three pips) is built by Smite in melee and by blows taken under the Ward, and spent by Judgement or Lay On.
identity: A mailed hybrid who earns Conviction up close and chooses, pip by pip, between a thrown Judgement and a saving Lay On.

branches.name: Oathguard
branches.loop: Hold attention with Oath of Ward, bank Conviction from blows taken under the Ward, and burn the ground you stand on.
branches.tradeoff: Conviction earned from blows is slow and only comes while the Ward is up; the branch gives nothing to Judgement's bite.

nodes.name: Steadfast
nodes.desc: +2% armor per rank, and Oath of Ward raises 10% more threat per rank on everything near you.

nodes.name: Bulwark of Faith
nodes.desc: Ward also raises a barrier worth 3% of your maximum health per rank for 8s.

nodes.name: Answering Light
nodes.desc: Blows taken under the Ward heal you for 2% of your maximum health per rank, at most once every 2s.

nodes.name: Censure
nodes.desc: New action: a blow that holds the target's next swing back for 2s.

nodes.name: Unbroken Oath
nodes.desc: Ward lasts 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Vigil
nodes.desc: Oath of Ward also holds the attention of 1/2/3 other enemies within 6m.

nodes.name: Hallowed Ground
nodes.desc: Enemies standing on your consecrated ground hit 10% softer.

branches.name: Judicator
branches.loop: Smite to three pips, throw Judgement, and keep the rhythm so a pip comes early.
branches.tradeoff: Everything feeds Judgement; a Judicator who spends pips on Lay On loses the branch's whole rhythm.

nodes.name: Zeal
nodes.desc: Smite hits 3% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Righteous Rhythm
nodes.desc: Every fourth/third/second Smite grants a second pip of Conviction.

nodes.name: Weighted Judgement
nodes.desc: Judgement deals 6 more per pip per rank.

nodes.name: Burning Light
nodes.desc: Judgement leaves the target burning: three ticks over 6s, scaling with rank and level.

nodes.name: Swift Verdict
nodes.desc: A Judgement thrown at three pips gives back 10 Mana.

nodes.name: Executioner
nodes.desc: Judgement hits 10% harder per rank against targets under 35% health.

nodes.name: Crusade
nodes.desc: Smite also strikes one other enemy within 4m of its target for half.

branches.name: Sanctuary
branches.loop: Keep the party up with Mend and Aegis, and hold three pips back for a Lay On when it matters.
branches.tradeoff: Pips held for Lay On never become Judgement, and a Paladin casting Mend is not swinging.

nodes.name: Devotion
nodes.desc: Mend heals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Light of Dawn
nodes.desc: Mend leaves a glow that heals a tenth of the Mend per rank, twice over 4s.

nodes.name: Grace
nodes.desc: Mend costs 2 less Mana per rank.

nodes.name: Aegis of Faith
nodes.desc: Aegis's barrier is 15% larger and lasts 2s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Beacon
nodes.desc: Lay On also grants its target an Aegis.

nodes.name: Mercy
nodes.desc: Lay On heals 8% more of the target's maximum health per rank.

nodes.name: Sanctuary
nodes.desc: Each second of Consecrate also heals you and Mira on the ground for 3% of maximum health.
